name: manual_070fb2
claim: A proxy that accounts spend from provider replies and cannot decode them must send Accept-Encoding: identity upstream in place of the client's value, and must treat a 2xx reply with any other Content-Encoding as unaccounted without parsing it. Do not rely on encoded bytes being unreadable: a stored-block gzip event stream still exposed its usage line and was accounted.

decisions.notes: orama-system fe063064; tests cover JSON and SSE replies in the launcher lifecycle tests.
